card.name: Inside Kampong and other rare names
card.fires_on: The pole responds to a piece partway through a rare proper name or drug name. The strongest case is "pong" in the Cambodian place name Kampong. Others are "erm" in Cockermouth and "olin" in gadolinium or Mussolini.

modes.label: Kampong provinces
modes.description: The "pong" in Kampong, in Cambodian province names such as Kampong Cham or Kampong Speu.
